diff --git a/tools/lint.sh b/tools/lint.sh
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..f5c6c91
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tools/lint.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+# Syntax-check every game script. CI runs this before packaging a build.
+set -e
+cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
+for f in docs/js/*.js docs/service_worker.js; do
+    node --check "$f"
+done
+echo "lint: ok"
